Methodology: Lasso regression (α=0.9, 10-year window) maps 13 factor/style ETF ratios vs SPY to each FX rate. Residual = (actual − model) / actual × 100. Positive residual → currency overvalued relative to factor signals; negative → undervalued.
Factors: MTUM (Momentum), SPHB (High Beta), IWC (Micro Cap), IVW (LG Growth), IJT (SC Growth), IJR (Small Cap), IJS (SC Value), IJK (MC Growth), QUAL (Quality), IJJ (MC Value), VYM (High Div), IVE (LG Value), USMV (Min Vol).

AI Commentary · google/gemma-4-31B-it · 2026-07-16 21:34 UTC
Value and high-dividend factors track global risk appetite and real yield differentials, as BRL typically correlates with "risk-on" flows into cyclical, value-oriented assets. The -10.3% residual indicates the BRL is fundamentally overvalued relative to these equity proxies, suggesting local idiosyncratic strength or central bank intervention is decoupling the currency from global factor trends. This implies a bearish bias for BRL, as the spot rate sits significantly below the model's fair value.
